name: Dwarf Cherry
desc: Dwarf Cherry (Prunus cerasus): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Prunus cerasus is an Old World species of Prunus in the subgenus Cerasus (cherries). It has two main groups of cultivars: the dark-red Morello cherry and the lighter-red Amarelle cherry.
